title: GhBEE3-Like gene regulated by brassinosteroids is involved in cotton drought tolerance.
authors: Chen, Eryong; Yang, Xiaobei; Liu, Ruie; Zhang, Mengke; Zhang, Meng; Zhou, Feng; Li, Dongxiao; Hu, Haiyan; Li, Chengwei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究棉花bHLH转录因子GhBEE3-Like受BR调控参与干旱耐受，通过EMSA和双荧光素酶实验验证GhBZR1与启动子E-box结合，属蛋白-DNA互作但偏实验验证，无AI或物理模拟方法，与课题方法轴不匹配。
abstract: Brassinosteroids (BRs) are important phytohormones that play a vital role in plant drought tolerance, but their mechanisms in cotton (Gossypium hirsutum L.) are poorly understood. Numerous basic helix-loop-helix (bHLH) family genes are involved in the responses to both BRs and drought stress. GhBEE3-Like, a bHLH transcription factor, is repressed by both 24-epi-BL (an active BR substance) and PEG8000 (drought simulation) treatments in cotton. Moreover, GhBZR1, a crucial transcription factor in BR signaling pathway, directly binds to the E-box element in GhBEE3-Like promoter region and inhibits its expression, which has been confirmed by electrophoretic mobility shift assay (EMSA) and dual luciferase reporter assay. Functional analysis revealed that Arabidopsis with GhBEE3-Like overexpression had drought sensitive phenotype, while GhBEE3-Like knock-down cotton plants obtained by virus-induced gene silencing (VIGS) technology were more tolerant to drought stress. Furthermore, the expression levels of three stress-related genes, GhERD10, GhCDPK1 and GhRD26, were significantly higher in GhBEE3-Like knock-down cotton than in control cotton after drought treatment. These results suggest that GhBEE3-Like is inhibited by BRs which elevates the expressions of stress-related genes to enhance plant drought tolerance. This study lays the foundation for understanding the mechanisms of BR-regulated drought tolerance and establishment of drought-resistant cotton lines.
abstract_zh: 油菜素内酯（BRs）是重要的植物激素，在植物耐旱性中发挥关键作用，但其在棉花（Gossypium hirsutum L.）中的作用机制尚不清楚。众多碱性螺旋-环-螺旋（bHLH）家族基因参与对BRs和干旱胁迫的响应。GhBEE3-Like，一种bHLH转录因子，在棉花中受24-表油菜素内酯（24-epi-BL，一种活性BR物质）和PEG8000（模拟干旱）处理的双重抑制。此外，BR信号通路中的关键转录因子GhBZR1直接结合于GhBEE3-Like启动子区域的E-box元件并抑制其表达，这一结论已通过电泳迁移率变动分析（EMSA）和双荧光素酶报告实验得到证实。功能分析显示，过表达GhBEE3-Like的拟南芥表现出干旱敏感表型，而通过病毒诱导基因沉默（VIGS）技术获得的GhBEE3-Like敲低棉花植株则更耐干旱胁迫。进一步研究发现，干旱处理后，GhBEE3-Like敲低棉花中三个胁迫相关基因GhERD10、GhCDPK1和GhRD26的表达水平显著高于对照棉花。这些结果表明，GhBEE3-Like受BRs抑制，从而提升胁迫相关基因的表达以增强植物耐旱性。本研究为理解BR调控耐旱性的机制及培育耐旱棉花品系奠定了基础。
